notes.title: CyberSurfer Early Alpha Playtest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43881431/53da7f4fab4f6cf59eadd56cd655d236ed70175a.png[/img]

Hey CyberSurfers,

We are SO EXCITED to release our playtest version of CyberSurfer on Steam! Using your mobile phone as the game controller, we need all the feedback we can get to create an intuitive controller for your all! 

At this stage of development, we want to focus on stable connectivity, user input, and hoverboard movement. So, please give us any suggestions, comments, and concerns to better the CyberSurfer experience. Our team has been working diligently our playtest version of the game, and we are eager to have you try it out.

[b]For those who have received access to the Steam Playtest, follow these steps to get started:
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43979241/0f81c642de23556316251ecc9c17e22df1a42239.gif[/img]
[h3]Download the Cybersurfer Mobile App from your respective app store:
[/h3]Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cybersurferllc.cyberphone

iOS: https://testflight.apple.com/join/l20KxOmz


You should have instant access to the mobile app after following the required steps from either App Store. (We are working on releasing the public versions of our mobile app for a smoother setup process.)

[h3]How do I play the game?
[/h3]
1. Open CyberSurfer the Game on Steam
2. Open the CyberSurfer Mobile App
3. Input the Game Code (Bottom-Left Corner) from CyberSurfer the Game into the CyberSurfer Mobile App
4. Press the "Connect" button on the CyberSurfer Mobile App
5. You are now able to control the virtual hoverboard

[h3]Playtest Feedback
[/h3]We encourage you to join our Discord community to share your thoughts, feedback, and connect with fellow players: https://discord.gg/F6sE58XaRB


Complete our Playtest Form to help us improve the game based on your experience: https://forms.gle/vDAQTJgsQdWErRrU6


[url=calebvaccaro@cybersurferllc.com]Contact us[/url], if you have any direct questions!

Thank you for your participation, and we look forward to your feedback.

Better Fly Fast,
The CyberSurfer Team

notes.title: CyberSurfer has entered the Universe!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Sorry it took so long, we've been zooming around black holes for the past 2 years! What started as a VR project turned into an ecosystem to generate more physical input in video games. Now as a small team of software engineers and artists we are here to redefine the definition of mixed reality! 

[h2]What is CyberSurfer?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43881431/31bf65568d3d7f9766332171dd641b2bb6f6cbde.gif[/img]
A cutting-edge hoverboard racing game that seamlessly transforms your mobile phone into an immersive controller. Inspired by Sonic Riders and SSX, choose from a diverse roster of characters and hoverboards, as you navigate exhilarating courses filled with obstacles and leap through black holes in pursuit of becoming the fastest CyberSurfer! 

[h2]Why use a phone as the controller?
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43881431/0f81c642de23556316251ecc9c17e22df1a42239.gif[/img]
Using a phone as the controller for our game opens up a world of possibilities to create a unique and engaging gaming experience. The hoverboard-inspired design, fluid 1:1 rotational movement, and ergonomic touchscreen interface allow for intuitive and fast-paced gameplay. With smartphone integration, players can enjoy portable player accounts, making it easy to race friends and compete on leaderboards wherever they go.

[h2]Cool gimic bro...what about actual gameplay?
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43881431/6f17ee4e6fbe34ce691112ad773187ba9a5e3dd1.gif[/img]
That's what we like to hear! We want extreme movement and competition right from the jump. Time trials, speed boosts, and pitstops to slow you down are all in the present playtest build and the core of any racing game. Things to come such as Black Holes to teleport you forward, grind rails to skip ahead and gravity switches to make you fly! 

The sky...no, the universe is the limit in terms of level design and that's one part we are currently working very hard on. We want to take the best aspects of racing games and open world titles to create the best paths for intricate choices on the racetrack. 

[h2]The Story[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43881431/9de55b76f8217371c8ca2a869864f8ccd1fa9d93.png[/img]
A high-speed race for survival in a cybernetic world of robots, cyborgs, and humans

Beneath the surface of this racing street culture lies a world rife with greed and inequality, where humanity struggles to survive. Meanwhile, the robots of Assimilation seek to conquer new galaxies and understand the universe, leaving cyborgs torn between two worlds.

The only place left to close this gap is the track.

[h2]Who are we?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43881431/df0857719fd0925510c945b424dcb10db4192b00.png[/img]
We are CyberSurfer, LLC! By combining bleeding edge mixed reality technology with fun design, we transport the player to worlds previously limited to the imagination. We enjoy physical movement, dancing, moving, grooving, so our phone controller is a great starting point to release CyberSurfer rather than a basic keyboard setup. Besides the next logical step would be to create a physical board controller that people can stand on and actually feel like you're on the hoverboard. I mean how crazy, dumb, and stupid that would be ;).

We appreciate you taking the time to take a peek at CyberSurfer and what we got going on. This is just the start and hope you get ready to zoom through space!

Are you gonna be the fastest?

Better Fly Fast,
The CyberSurfer Team
